text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, Trainer. My legs are shaking.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry.
My body's just telling me 
that it wants to run right this second.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The effort put in up to today,
the heat of 
the venue, the greatest opponents—they're 
all pushing my body forward...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna turn this heat into radiance 
right now! A radiance worthy of an ace!
